author: Analyst notes based on the verified items in this tracker
headline: The leading free zones have moved from talking about AI to running on it. DIFC has committed to becoming an 'AI-native' financial centre and ADGM already runs AI in 25 of its own functions. DMCC's AI profile today is thought leadership and governance, without a comparable flagship programme.

findings.title: AI is now a whole-of-zone strategy for the two leaders
findings.text: DIFC targets USD 3.5bn in economic value and 25,000 jobs from becoming AI-native. ADGM has AI live across licensing, supervision and customer service, backed by an AED 400m roadmap to 2029.

findings.title: AI capital and AI firms are concentrating in the financial centres
findings.text: ADGM entities hold more than USD 100bn in AI-focused investment (anchored by MGX). DIFC's AI, FinTech and innovation firms grew 39% in a year to 1,933, and it is winning AI infrastructure firms such as Positron AI.

findings.title: Smaller zones compete on compute and niches
findings.text: RAK's Innovation City now rents sovereign NVIDIA B200 GPU capacity to its licensees. KEZAD signed an AI manufacturing anchor (ROX), and DSO hosts Dubai's autonomous-vehicle test labs.

findings.title: AI talent programmes with public targets are table stakes
findings.text: ADGM trained 544 Emiratis in agentic AI, Shams 300+ government staff, and Dubai AI Campus added a female-founder accelerator. Hub71 runs an AI programme with Mastercard.

recommendations.title: Name a flagship AI proposition for trade and commodities
recommendations.text: Turn the Future of Trade finding (AI drives 43% of trade growth) into a member-facing programme with measurable targets, as DIFC and ADGM have done.

recommendations.title: Publish DMCC's own AI adoption results
recommendations.text: ADGM now quotes 25 AI-enabled functions and 5,000 hours saved. Equivalent metrics for DMCC member services would neutralise that comparison.

recommendations.title: Offer members access to AI compute through partners
recommendations.text: Innovation City shows that GPU access is a differentiator. A partnership for GPU credits or sovereign compute would cost little and match the move.

recommendations.title: Lead on AI governance from the AI & Agentics Council
recommendations.text: DMCC's council with Deloitte is a unique asset. Pair it with a talent programme with a public target to match peers' skills numbers.
